title: VIP - Vascular Infection Project
official: VIP - Vascular Infection Project : Prospective Multicentric Database on Vascular Infections
summary: Constitution of a prospective multicentric observational database to study vascular infections, both native, especially aortitis, and vascular graft and endograft infections. Clinical and paraclinical data on medical, surgical, anesthetic and intensive care management will be collected in order to better characterize these infections
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ≥ 18 years-old;
* all patients with a vascular infection, either native (aortitis, arteritis) or prosthetic (vascular graft, endograft and/or stent),
* oral consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* patient under legal protection
